::: {.hero}
# Causality Lab

Research group in causal inference at the Department of Statistics and
Operations Research, University of Granada.
:::

## What we do

We develop and apply causal inference methods for questions that matter
in health research: what is the effect of an exposure, an intervention,
or a policy on an outcome, when randomisation is not possible.

Work in the group spans targeted maximum likelihood estimation, doubly
robust and machine-learning-based estimators, and the potential outcomes
framework, applied to epidemiological and clinical data.
